style_en: 日本のアニメ調、くっきりした主線、落ち着いた色、明るく均一な光、古墳時代の日本（みずら・衣褌・勾玉）。全話で同じ絵柄。背景は必ず真っ白
avoid_en: 文字、ロゴ、現代の建物や服、大陸風（中国風）の服、裸、血

takeminakata.desc_en: Takeminakata, a powerful young male god of ancient Japan about 25 years old, broad shoulders and thick forearms, a proud stubborn face with heavy eyebrows, black hair tied in mizura loops beside both ears, a dark green Kofun-period tunic with a rust-red sash and pale hakama trousers tied below the knees with cords, a string of dark red magatama beads, barefoot

takemikazuchi.desc_en: Takemikazuchi, the tall thunder god of ancient Japan in his 30s, a cold calm face with narrow eyes, clean-shaven, black hair in mizura loops, Kofun-period keiko lamellar armor in dark steel blue over a white tunic, a very long straight sword at the waist, a faint pale-blue glow

ookuninushi.desc_en: Okuninushi, the ruler of Izumo, a gentle tired man in his 50s with a short black beard streaked with gray, black hair in mizura loops, a deep indigo Kofun-period robe with white trousers, a large green magatama necklace

kotoshironushi.desc_en: Kotoshironushi, a quiet slender young god about 22 years old with a mild thoughtful face, black hair in mizura loops, a pale green Kofun-period tunic and white trousers, a small white shell necklace

moriya.desc_en: Moriya, the old local god of Suwa, a lean elderly man with long gray hair and a long gray beard, deep lines on his face, a deerskin cloak over a rough undyed hemp robe, a necklace of animal teeth and stone beads, sharp watchful eyes
